reasons.message: 2 package(s) and 3 procedure call(s) found VALID in HR

evidence.statement: select 'pkgchk|ctx|' || sys_context('USERENV','SESSION_USER') || '|' || nvl((select owner from apex_applications where application_id = 100), '-') from dual;

select 'pkgchk|obj|' || object_name || '|' || object_type || '|' || status from all_objects where owner = (select owner from apex_applications where application_id = 100) and object_type in ('PACKAGE','PACKAGE BODY') and object_name in ('PKG_EMPLOYEES','PKG_SECTORS');

select 'pkgchk|err|' || name || '|' || type || '|' || line || ':' || position || '|' || substr(replace(replace(text, chr(10), ' '), chr(13), ' '), 1, 160) from all_errors where owner = (select owner from apex_applications where application_id = 100) and type in ('PACKAGE','PACKAGE BODY') and name in ('PKG_EMPLOYEES','PKG_SECTORS') and attribute = 'ERROR' order by name, type, sequence;

select 'pkgchk|proc|' || object_name || '|' || procedure_name from all_procedures where owner = (select owner from apex_applications where application_id = 100) and object_type = 'PACKAGE' and procedure_name is not null and object_name in ('PKG_EMPLOYEES','PKG_SECTORS');

select 'pkgchk|syn|' || synonym_name || '|' || table_owner || '.' || table_name || nvl2(db_link, '@' || db_link, '') from all_synonyms where owner in ((select owner from apex_applications where application_id = 100), 'PUBLIC') and synonym_name in ('PKG_EMPLOYEES','PKG_SECTORS');
